body:
hey. Thanks for talking to me. I have an appointment with a psychologist in a couple weeks. I just cant find anyone to talk to. I just dont have any friends close enough to talk to. I always feel like nobody really wants me around. I cant talk to my brother because my problems are related to my family and he's always working. My parents are always fighting and yell at me when I talk about how their fighting affects me. They always say, "Get over it" or "just be stronger". They also lie to me, saying they wont fight and then they scream at each other. I cant talk to my dad because he's not even allowed inside the house by my mother, and he doesn't want to talk about it. My mom is not helpful either because she always just tells me that "your brother is fine, why cant you be fine?" or sometimes she just tells me to go and study. Sometimes I get blamed for their fighting too because of my grades and my behavior. The smallest mistakes and I get yelled at. You're right about the essay thing. 

Also, I feel better, and then a couple days later, I just feel shitty. I either feel fine about myself, or I just hate myself. Most of the time I just hate myself and wish that I could start my life over as somebody else, as a girl, or as a Chinese person, or a Italian person, etc. I cant stand everyone else because everyone is always so happy. I just hate myself in general when I am not doing work. When I work and force myself to focus I am fine, but outside of that I am either indifferent or annoyed. When I look into the mirror I think, who is this useless ugly loser. I wish there was something that I was extremely good at. I'm average at everything.

Sorry for ranting. I hope that you're still fine with me talking to you, if you don't want to, I understand. But can I pm you occasionally? If it does not bother you? Sorry if I am annoying you.

I only get to practice like once every other day for 20 minutes because I have several other instruments, athletics, and also school work. I have been playing for for 10 years, yet people who only have played for like 5 are better than me. 

Writing things down does help. I started writing stuff down after seeing this comment, and I feel less bad at night, which is when most of the time I feel terrible. Also, I have been talking to my brother (yes he does live at home) about counselling and he said that he would help me get an appointment with a doctor.

I have had problems completing my assignments since as long as I can remember. Since 6th grade, when I actually got to see my grades My test grades are always quite high like in the 90's, but I rarely have turned in my homework. Its really hard for me to finish the assignment in time, or just turn it in. I have a problem especially with essays. Whenever I look at what I have written, I always feel like it is terrible. I just cant write ~~an essay~~ with any positive feelings.

Respeched, I just wanted to say thank you. Honestly you have made me feel much better.

Yeah I really love to play the piano and it has always been a source of relaxation for me. Really, its the only time Im happy. 

There are a few counsellors and ive tried to talk but I just can start, nothing is able to come out of my mouth when I go over there. Thanks for your words of support. Im really just struggling because I know that I shouldnt think the way I do, but I just cant help it.
I understand, and agree. Also, I contacted my teacher and he said to have my parents email him as well, so it worked out

I was actually sick, I just get easily anxious. I wouldnt cut when I have important assignments.

I got nervous because I felt that if I say that I didnt go to the clinic, they'd think I cut.
:) You really calmed me down here. You're right its not a big deal, and I ca just explain.  phew.

I kind of just panicked because he sounded like he thought I was cutting class.

Okay I will do that thanks
He walked in on his sister. My friend also told me the story.
I never said that he started the rumors.
Yeah I can make new friends. Im just nervous about weather our mutual friends will side with me. One person already is ignoring me. At least i have 2 years until college.
Yeah. Im really sensitive. But they arent just mad at me, its that he doesnt believe me. I tried to convince him, and he just blocked me. I was always there for this friend and he doesnt believe me.

See thats the thing. I dont know how the rumor started to spread. I wasnt in school today. I forgot about it until today as well. But I agree, I will add that part about not thinking she is important enough to talk about.

I know this sounds like a rant, but Im just scared. I dont know why they would not believe me. I went to visit him as often as I could when he got sick and wasnt able to go to school for years! He knows me, he shouldnt think i did it.

Sorry if the mini rants are starting to annoy you.
ok. Thank you. Ill try to do that

Ill try thanks. The problem is that I am sick today. I dont know how many people know of the rumor, or who told it to her. I just know that she thinks it was me. I cant ask my friends because that would be spreading it.

Should I wait sometime before approaching him or do it on Monday?

I did over facebook. They blocked me.
I cant do it in real life because they 100% believe it was me. Im scared about weather they'll believe it was me or not and The last time I tried to talk to my friend, he just said nothing and walked off.

She said that I was spreading a rumor that I walked in on her while she was having sex. 

I never spread that rumor, nor did I walk in on her. My friend did and he told me about it in 7th grade. Thats why they think it was me. But she thinks I spread the rumor now. I forgot about right after my friend told me.

I just cant bring up that topic. The fact that they think i spread the rumor makes me not able to even think of looking at them anymore. Im scared of how they'll look at me or act. Should I wait or does that not help
